card.fact_statement: Shigeru Ishiba was the incumbent LDP president prior to the 2025 Liberal Democratic Party presidential election.
card.source_span: The election was triggered by the resignation of Prime Minister of Japan and LDP president Shigeru Ishiba

target_qa_variants.question: من كان شاغل منصب رئيس الحزب الليبرالي الديمقراطي قبل انتخابات رئاسة الحزب الليبرالي الديمقراطي لعام 2025؟
target_qa_variants.source_span: The election was triggered by the resignation of Prime Minister of Japan and LDP president Shigeru Ishiba
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'incumbent president' as 'شاغل منصب رئيس' (incumbent of the position of president) for natural Arabic phrasing. 'LDP' and 'Liberal Democratic Party' are both translated to the full Arabic name 'الحزب الليبرالي الديمقراطي' as Arabic does not use an acronym for it.

backtranslation_en.question: Who was holding the position of president of the Liberal Democratic Party before the 2025 Liberal Democratic Party presidential election?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source question and expected answer, preserving the exact same fact and intent.
